hf_papers.title: AV-FABLE: Audio-Visual Manipulation Forensics in Long-Form Videos
hf_papers.abstract: AV-FABLE introduces a long-form audio-visual benchmark for sparse manipulations, showing that frozen perception features of audio-visual large language models contain forensic evidence best recovered via separate temporal decoders rather than language outputs.

hf_papers.title: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
hf_papers.abstract: TAO improves scheduling for LLM agent services by considering tool readiness and using dynamic programming to place sessions, reducing latency and increasing throughput.

hf_papers.title: On the SPOT: Enhancing Speculative Decoding for Diffusion Language Models via Commit-Order Prediction
hf_papers.abstract: SPOT accelerates diffusion language models by predicting token generation order and verifying candidates in parallel, reducing passes up to 6.8x while maintaining exact decoding.

hf_papers.title: DirCast: Live Esports Directing and Commentary with a Single Streaming Video-Language Model
hf_papers.abstract: DirCast is a streaming video language model that simultaneously directs live esports broadcasts by selecting cameras and generates real-time commentary using only past context.

hf_papers.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
hf_papers.abstract: EmbeddingGemma 2 is an open multimodal embedding model that unifies text, images, audio, and video representations with efficient resource-flexible design and state-of-the-art benchmark performance.

hf_papers.title: Speculative Diffusion is a Tale of Two Tradeoffs
hf_papers.abstract: This paper explores trading inference speed for output quality in speculative decoding by jointly adjusting diffusion effort and acceptance leniency to extend the speed-quality Pareto frontier.

hf_papers.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
hf_papers.abstract: Sensorimotor alignment measures how sensory representations match physical motion geometry, serving as a low-cost offline predictor of robot model performance.

hf_papers.title: miniTE: Diagnosing and Bridging the Execution Gap in Native NVFP4 Reinforcement Learning
hf_papers.abstract: MiniTE enables stable low-bit reinforcement learning for large language models by aligning cross-engine numerical execution and accelerating native 4-bit computation.

hf_papers.title: CausalAlign: Causal Alignment of Video Generation Models for Consistent Ego-Motion
hf_papers.abstract: CausalAlign improves long-horizon camera ego-motion consistency in diffusion video generators by aligning internal representations to 3D dynamics via delta-token space.

hf_papers.title: Harness-Model Collaboration for Long-Horizon Continual Learning
hf_papers.abstract: HaMo combines rapid retrieval of procedural experience cards with gradual model adaptation to improve long-horizon web agents' retention and cross-task execution.

hf_papers.title: Extreme Compression of Per-Layer Embeddings via Cross-Layer Latent Vector Quantization
hf_papers.abstract: OPTIC achieves extreme compression of per-layer embeddings by using token-shared indexed codes and layer-specific affine decoders fitted to the output path, preserving most model performance at up to 1000x compression with minimal inference overhead.

hf_papers.title: Co-Design Bench: Multimodal Collaborative Coding Evaluation for Agentic Models
hf_papers.abstract: Evaluating human-AI co-design requires testing whether coding agents can translate real users' multimodal requests into working application revisions. We introduce Co-Design Bench, a reference-free benchmark of 273 tasks curated from 37,463 deduplicated queries across 26,314 real user coding sessions. Its two tracks, Multimodal Editing (ME) and Repository Editing (RE), cover localized edits with o

hf_papers.title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
hf_papers.abstract: LongChang evaluates whether LLMs can autonomously discover altered physical laws through simulated experimentation, finding that only one model achieved limited success.

hf_papers.title: PersonaCUABench: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents Serving Diverse Personas
hf_papers.abstract: PersonaCUABench reveals that computer-use agents frequently fail to satisfy real user requirements and constraints, reducing task completion and satisfaction compared to fixed benchmark instructions.

hf_papers.title: Channel Selection for Mixture-of-Experts Decoding Needs No Calibration Data
hf_papers.abstract: Prox replaces calibrated thresholds with top-k channel selection and a weight-derived reader to accelerate Mixture-of-Experts inference while preserving accuracy.

hf_papers.title: MultiAgent-OPD: End-to-End Training of Hierarchical Multi-Agent Systems with On-Policy Distillation
hf_papers.abstract: MultiAgent-OPD jointly trains a hierarchical multi-agent team via on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning, using a frozen teacher for local process supervision to improve end-to-end performance across multiple datasets.

hf_papers.title: CoSTA: Compressed Speech Token Adaptation for Efficient Spoken Dialogue Models
hf_papers.abstract: CoSTA decouples generation and synthesis token spaces to accelerate spoken dialogue models while preserving quality and compatibility.

hf_papers.title: The Lexical Imprint of Pre-training Data
hf_papers.abstract: Pre-training corpora leave a lexical imprint on zero-shot accuracy that is consistently tracked by word-level unigram cross-entropy across benchmarks, document selection, and prompt routing.

hf_papers.title: JockeyBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Horse-Racing Decision-Making
hf_papers.abstract: JockeyBench evaluates repeated event forecasting via Japanese horse racing, finding that reusable predictors improve efficiency but all configurations yield negative average betting returns.

hf_papers.title: Easy-3Dfy: Object-Level Geometric Composition for Single-Image 3D Scene Construction
hf_papers.abstract: Easy-3Dfy separates object generation from scene layout estimation and uses geometric alignment to combine high-quality 3D objects with spatial understanding for improved scene reconstruction.

hf_papers.title: Multi-Token Prediction Done Right
hf_papers.abstract: Soft-MTP removes a noisy gradient residual from multi-token prediction via a straight-through KL recovery trick, improving perplexity, speculative decoding, and reasoning without added cost.

hf_papers.title: TauIndianBankBench: Procedure-Aware, Action-Oriented Evaluation of Tool-Using Conversational Agents
hf_papers.abstract: TauIndianBankBench evaluates language model assistants on Indian retail banking by verifying both procedural compliance and final outcomes across 1,000 simulated tasks.

hf_papers.title: Evaluating DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 for loss of control and harmful manipulation risks
hf_papers.abstract: Independent safety evaluation of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 reveals substantial improvements over prior versions and near-parity with leading closed-source models, while recommending process-level observability, incremental safety testing, and private benchmarks.

hf_papers.title: PreView: Enhancing GUI Grounding with Preprocessed Views and Cues
hf_papers.abstract: PreView is an auxiliary preprocessor that enhances GUI grounding by providing localized zoomed views and visual-textual target cues to frozen grounding models, improving accuracy without retraining.
